Wet-Stator Motor Specialists

BCP Motor Repair & Rewinding

Specialist repair and rewind support for the wet-stator motors at the heart of sealless Boiler Circulation Pumps.

Submit an RFQ

The motor is the heart of a sealless boiler circulation pump. Its stator and rotor run in water at system pressure and temperature, so the winding insulation, protective cans and bearings all work under demanding conditions. When something fails, a general motor shop is not enough. DEI VOX repairs and rewinds BCP wet-stator motors as a dedicated specialty.

Service Detail

Understanding the BCP Motor

In a sealless BCP, the pump and motor share one shaft inside a single pressure boundary. That removes the shaft seal and its leak path. The motor is a water-filled induction motor: a thin stator can protects the windings, a rotor can protects the rotor, and circulating water lubricates the internal bearings. A cooling circuit keeps the motor cavity at a safe temperature. Winding insulation, can integrity, bearings and cooling-water quality all affect motor life.

Service Detail

Signs Your BCP Motor Needs Attention

  • Falling insulation-resistance readings
  • Changes in winding resistance or phase imbalance
  • Rising vibration or unusual noise
  • Rising motor-cavity temperature or cooling-circuit problems
  • Evidence of water or debris contamination in the motor
  • Bearing wear found during an inspection or outage
  • Trips or abnormal current during start-up or warm standby

If you see these signs, send the nameplate, test readings and fault history for a free technical opinion.

Service Detail

Our Repair & Rewinding Process

  1. 01

    Receipt & incoming inspection

    The motor is logged, photographed and checked against the nameplate and available drawings.

  2. 02

    Initial electrical tests

    Insulation resistance, winding resistance and other applicable tests are recorded before teardown.

  3. 03

    Teardown & condition report

    Components are measured; the failure mode and likely root cause are documented.

  4. 04

    Scope & quotation

    A clear scope, price and timeline are provided for approval before work proceeds.

  5. 05

    Rewinding & repair

    Work follows controlled procedures, with materials and insulation system matched to the design.

  6. 06

    Reassembly & fit checks

    Clearances, alignment and assembly dimensions are verified.

  7. 07

    Final testing

    Electrical, pressure-boundary and mechanical checks are carried out as applicable.

  8. 08

    Documentation & dispatch

    Test records and a repair summary accompany export-ready packing.
